svg.aria-label: How htl works. Turn 1: Claude hits a job it cannot do, tries its own tools, then calls assign_task. The mod checks the request and either refuses it with what to fix, or shows the task in a pane and tells Claude it is assigned, so Claude ends its turn. While Claude is idle, you do the job and pick Accept, Reject or You can do this, with an optional message. The mod sends that as your message, which starts turn 2: Claude checks and continues, finds another way, or does the job itself.
